owner_choice: Accept a stop threshold with possible overrun
approval_scope: Budget-policy choice only; not permission to send data or make paid calls
monitoring_basis: Grok provider-reported billing ticks plus Gemini/MiniMax undiscounted token estimates converted to ticks; keep the subtotals separate
dispatch_rule: Start only while monitoring amount is below the threshold, all previous attempts have known accounting, no request is in flight, and the exact next scheduled row is eligible
settlement_rule: Retain and count the last response, then stop when the monitoring amount reaches or exceeds the threshold; unknown accounting or any technical failure stops immediately
limits: Final-request overrun is not numerically bounded. Estimates are not an invoice; missing replies can still incur charges, and local cancellation does not prove remote cancellation. No account-wide spending guarantee.
remaining: Real HTTPS connector and production schedule integration with approval admission
Final generation settings and complete live-protocol freeze
Explicit first-phase data-export, request-count and billing approval; confirmation needs its own later authorization
